title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.38293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quarterly earnings forecasting requires an agent to connect financial evidence to the income-statement line items that produce a company's reported earnings. We introduce EPSBench, a benchmark for studying this ability across 149 firm-quarters from 86 US companies. Agents read a fixed collection of filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news, then estimate company-specific income-statement drivers with cited evidence. A shared accounting calculator converts these estimates into GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS), providing a common basis for comparing forecast assumptions. We evaluate six models under a common harness, assessing point forecast error relative to date-matched analyst consensus and checking whether their prediction intervals achieve the stated coverage. translated_title: EPSBench：面向盈利预测的大语言模型智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 季度盈利预测要求智能体将财务证据与产生公司报告收益的利润表科目联系起来。我们提出了EPSBench，这是一个用于研究这种能力的基准，涵盖86家美国公司的149个公司季度。智能体阅读一组固定的资料，包括申报文件、业绩电话会议记录和新闻，然后引用证据来估计公司特定的利润表驱动因素。一个共享的会计计算器将这些估计值转换为GAAP稀释每股收益（EPS），为比较不同的预测假设提供了共同基础。我们在统一的评测框架下评估了六个模型，评估其点预测误差相对于日期匹配的分析师共识的表现，并检查其预测区间是否达到所述的覆盖率。三个模型在点预测误差上与共识没有可检测到的配对差异，另外三个模型的误差更高。在所有六个模型中，名义80%的预测区间……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出EPSBench基准，让大语言模型智能体基于财报、业绩电话会议记录和新闻并引用证据来估计利润表驱动因素，再通过共享会计计算器转换为GAAP稀释EPS，从而系统评估其季度盈利预测能力，发现六个模型中三个的点预测误差与分析师共识无显著差异、另外三个误差更高。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EPSBench, a benchmark where LLM agents estimate income-statement drivers from filings, earnings-call transcripts, and news with cited evidence, which a shared accounting calculator converts into GAAP diluted EPS, finding that three of six models show no detectable paired difference in point forecast error from analyst consensus while the other three have higher error.
